dedupe_keys.name: mcmc internet users survey and broadband quality of experience survey malaysia

description: MCMC runs national consumer surveys on communications in Malaysia. The Internet Users Survey, with editions for 2012, 2014, 2016, 2017, 2018, 2020, 2022 and 2024 (released in October 2025), describes internet users, their access devices, locations and activities. The Broadband Quality of Experience Survey (BQoES), whose fourth edition covering 2024 was released in October 2025 as a 39-page report with an infographic, measures satisfaction of fixed and mobile broadband consumers through a customer satisfaction index by service aspect, service quality gap analysis, importance-performance analysis, consumption patterns and demographic profiles; earlier editions cover 2021, 2022 and 2023. The statistics pages also list a broadband demand survey, hand phone users surveys, consumer satisfaction and e-commerce consumer surveys. Coverage: Malaysia. Format and access: PDF reports and infographics on the MCMC website, free; reproduction for non-commercial use with acknowledgement of MCMC. Caveats: sample surveys with methods that change between editions; results are in PDF only. Simulation uses: user behaviour and satisfaction as inputs to agent-based models of how people respond to broadband degradation, and weights for service importance. Related records: MCMC Facts and Figures gives subscriptions and coverage, and the Brazilian ICT household survey and APJII survey are comparable national surveys.
